summary: Blue Ridge Labs is accepting applications for its 2027 Catalyst cohort, with a November 13 cutoff. The current canonical program page replaces the password-protected beta URL.

proposed_event.name: Blue Ridge Labs Catalyst 2027
proposed_event.description: $100K investment for for-profit ventures or grant for nonprofits; MVP and early traction required. Solo founders may apply.

dates.date_range_text: Apply by November 13 for the 2027 cohort. Program phases are February–March and April–June 2027; exact start/end days and cutoff time are not published.
